action_items.task: Spec out the dual-write period for rollback.

decisions.text: Migration will target Q4 with a Q1 buffer.
Rollback approach will be a dual-write period rather than a hard cutover.
No contractor will be hired for this project.

key_quotes: We need to decide whether the migration lands in Q4 or slips to Q1.
Then we're deciding to target Q4 with a Q1 buffer.
Decision: we do a dual-write period rather than a hard cutover.
summary: The team discussed the Q4 migration timeline, deciding to target Q4 with a Q1 buffer. They also agreed on a dual-write period for the rollback strategy and opted against hiring a contractor for the project. Action items were assigned to Tom and Priya with specific due dates.
title: Q4 Planning
